quote_text: You know that there is a 5 match test series going on between India and Australia . India won the 1st test match while Australia lost it. By defeating India, Australia won the 2nd test match. Sad! People were excited for the 3rd test match which was from 14th December 2024 to 18th December 2024. People's excitement died when the 3rd test match ended in a draw. With Travis Head's 152 runs, Australia scored 445 runs in the first innings. However, India's star bowler Jasprit Bumrah took 6 wickets. Against Australia's 445, India were all out for 260. However, people were relaxed even with 260 runs as it saved the follow on and hoped the match would end in a draw. Confused with the word Follow On? What does it mean? I'll explain. Follow on rules applies in test cricket and is the difference of 200 runs. I'll give you an example. If Team A batting first scores 500 runs and Team B, batting second scores 301 runs and difference is less than 200 runs, the first team bats again. But if Team B scores less than 301 and the difference is more than 200 runs, Team A can ask team B to bat again. It is called Follow On. Hope it is clear now! During a match between India and Australia on 11th March 2001, Australia scored 445 runs. India were all out for a very low score and was given a follow on. However, thanks to VVS Laxman and Rahul Dravid's batting, India scored a total of 657 runs and declared the innings. Australia had a target of 384 runs but were all out and India won the match. Do you know, generally, the team batting second that gets a follow on, loses the match or it ends in a draw. Very few teams after follow on win the match. In regards to this, in the recent 3rd India - Australia test match which ended in a draw, everyone was excited as against Australia's 445, India had to score 246 to avoid follow on. If India would have scored below 246, Australia would have given a follow on and there was a risk of India losing the match. India lost 9 wickets at just 213 runs. but needed 33 more runs to save the follow on. It seemed difficult . The last batters were Jasprit Bumrah and Akash Deep who are skilled bowlers. However, with amazing batting they scored 39 runs which helped India score 260 runs and avoid the follow on. Australia then batted again and the match finally ended in a draw. This is what follow on means where the difference should be of 200 runs. On 16th December 2024, Jasprit Bumrah attended a press conference, where a reporter asked him about India’s poor batting. He also added that Jasprit might not be the best person to ask the question since he is a bowler. Bumrah was surprised at this sarcastic comment. He responded, "You should check Google and see the record for who has scored the most runs in a single over in a Test match." He was referring to when he smashed England bowler Stuart Broad for 34 runs in one over in test cricket. Bunmrah gave a befitting reply to the sarcastic comment. There was a sad moment at the end of the third test as Ravichandran Ashwin announced his retirement from international cricket The news soon went viral on social media. Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Australian cricketer Pat Cummins, and many others have written on social media about Ashwin's retirement. In his tweet Virat Kohli thanked Ashwin for 14 years of partnership, and wishing him and his family the best. Head Coach, Gautam Gambhir, to wished him all the best and said that he felt lucky to witness Ashwin’s journey from a young bowler to a cricket legend who will be missed. A lot of people too commented. Everyone spoke positively about Ashwin. However, only his father's remark was negative. In an interview, Ashwin’s father was asked by the media how he felt about his son's retirement. He replied that the announcement of retirement came as a surprise to him as well. He said there would be many reasons and suggested asking Ashwin directly. However, he said that one of the reasons would be Ashwin facing humiliation by not getting selected for matches. He said that this is his view. Everyone including the media was shocked by this negative remark. Ashwin immediately posted on Twitter saying that his father is not trained to talk to the media and asked fans to leave him alone. He said that was his decision and like many other retired cricketer's fathers, his father too tried to make a statement But there is no such issue. He requested the media to leave his father alone. People are doubting whether Ashwin's father was true or Ashwin's clarification. Recently there was a video on social media about Virat Kohli arguing at the airport in Australia. According to 7News, Kohli was seen talking to a female reporter, upset about cameras targeting his family. Kohli, frustrated by the cameras, stated he needs privacy with his kids and can't be filmed without permission. Virat Kohli arrived in Melbourne for the 4th Test of the Border-Gavaskar Trophy which starts on 24th December 2024. The argument went viral on social media. Meanwhile, there were reports that Kohli plans to move to London, UK soon with his wife, Anushka, and children. This was reported by Kohli's childhood coach, Rajkumar Sharma who said that Kohli would shift to UK with family. Let's see what the future holds for them and wait for updates!
